title: Invalid comparison with None
detail: The condition compares `max_digits <= decimal_places` when `max_digits` is None, which raises a TypeError at runtime.
note: Names the comparison of a None `max_digits` with `<=`.

title: __Host- cookies always rejected
detail: The function returns False for any cookie whose name starts with "__host-" because the first part of the return expression is "not name.startswith("__host-")", which is always False for such cookies. Consequently, valid __Host- cookies that satisfy the required conditions (secure, https, path="/", no domain) are never accepted, breaking the intended behavior.
note: Says `__Host-` cookies are always rejected, which the planted `and` does.
